layouts.name: Fintray Hill Climb
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The Grampian Automobile Club identifies the Fintray House hillclimb and describes a 725-yard (663 m) timed course. The selected independently mapped road retains the lower curved approach, the main eastern hairpin and the short western hairpin before the northern finish straight. The eastern farm-yard detour is excluded. Both source endpoints agree with the separate timing positions. This 644.9 m source-node selection differs from the 737 m catalogue scalar and the published timed distance; approach/run-on extent, sparse hairpin detail and historical alignment remain provisional. No vertices are moved to match those distances. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 644.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
